name: DNALONGBENCH
description: A suite of benchmark tasks and datasets for evaluating long-range DNA sequence prediction models across genomics tasks.
reputation: An emerging benchmark suite for long-range genomic sequence modeling that is gaining attention among bioinformatics and ML researchers focusing on long-context architectures.
notes: Covers non-LLM genomic sequence tasks with potential contamination from reference genomes; scores and difficulty vary substantially by subtask and evaluation metric.
